title: Visual effects

plain_text:
Visual effects are defined as any subjective effect which directly alters a person's sense of sight.

This page lists and describes the various visual effects which can occur under the influence of certain psychoactive compounds. It also further organizes these effects into subcategories based on their features and behavior. 

Visual amplifications

Visual suppressions

Visual distortions

Geometry

Hallucinatory states

See also

*Psychedelics
*Dissociatives
*Deliriants
*Hallucinogens
